OR % 16.01.2024 CRL.M.A. 1371/2024 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439(1) read with Section 482 Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.) for grant of interim bail for a period of 30 days in FIR bearing No.720/2023, registered at Police Station Shahbad Dairy, Delhi for offences punishable under Sections 376/323/328/506 Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
4. Issue notice.
Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to file Status Report.
Let Status Report be filed at least three days prior to the next date of hearing.
